title: Letter construction detail
slide_intent: Compare geometry with optical correction because mechanically similar forms can produce uneven reading rhythm.
strategic_value: Controlled curves, spacing and proportions can give Lufthansa type both precision and readable character.
demonstration: Large c, f, x, n and 9 forms sit over pale guides with cyan contours and measurement arrows.
practical_value: Inspect curves, diagonals and counters together before applying a geometric rule to a whole alphabet.
